input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration FROM trips WHERE duration_min > 30 AND bike_type = 'classic_bike' OR (bike_type = 'electric_bike' AND duration_min > 25);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rides, COUNT(DISTINCT rider_key) AS riders,
  ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 2) AS avg_duration_min,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_rides,
  SUM(CASE WHEN duration_min > 45.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rides_over_free_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 1.0 + 0.49 * CEIL(duration_min)
                 ELSE 1.0 + 0.19 * CEIL(duration_min) END), 2) AS payg_total,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * CEIL(duration_min)
                 ELSE 0.17 * GREATEST(CEIL(duration_min) - 45.0, 0) END), 2)
    AS member_residual_total,
  CAST(MIN(CAST(started_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS VARCHAR) AS first_ride,
  CAST(MAX(CAST(started_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS VARCHAR) AS last_ride,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MIN(CAST(started_at AS TIMESTAMP)), MAX(CAST(started_at AS TIMESTAMP))) + 1 AS days_covered
FROM trips WHERE duration_min > 0

SELECT CAST(week_start AS VARCHAR) AS week, COUNT(*) AS rides,
  ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_duration_min,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 1.0 + 0.49 * CEIL(duration_min)
                 ELSE 1.0 + 0.19 * CEIL(duration_min) END), 2) AS payg_spend,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * CEIL(duration_min)
                 ELSE 0.17 * GREATEST(CEIL(duration_min) - 45.0, 0) END), 2)
    AS member_residual_spend
FROM trips WHERE duration_min > 0 GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN member_cost < payg_cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS riders_cheaper_with_membership,
  COUNT(*) AS riders, ROUND(MEDIAN(rides), 1) AS median_rides_per_rider
FROM (SELECT rider_key, COUNT(*) AS rides,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 1.0 + 0.49 * CEIL(duration_min)
                 ELSE 1.0 + 0.19 * CEIL(duration_min) END) AS payg_cost,
        1 * 29.0 + SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * CEIL(duration_min)
                 ELSE 0.17 * GREATEST(CEIL(duration_min) - 45.0, 0) END) AS member_cost
      FROM trips WHERE duration_min > 0 GROUP BY rider_key) t

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN duration_min <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_positive_durations,
  SUM(CASE WHEN duration_min > 1440 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_24h,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bike_type NOT IN ('classic_bike', 'electric_bike') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_bike_types
FROM trips
